step: mix with malt extract and flour, dry
text: Wheat flour and ground barley malt are mashed, so the malt enzymes convert insoluble starch into sugars (maltose, dextrins). The mash extract is mixed with milk, evaporated to a syrup in a vacuum pan and dried under vacuum to a powder. Whether the milk goes in fresh or as powder varies; the arrow in the graph starts from milk powder, the modern route. No source I could open gave mash temperature, time or the malt/flour/milk ratio.
